short_description:
Where is the shoe store in GTA 6? The first one is Flip Flop House, off Sunbelt Highway in Key Lento (on the left coming from the north). To find the rest, open the map, pick Style, then the Footwear filter: guides count 14 to 17 shoe stores. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PowerPyx, Gamertweak, GTABase, Xboxplay, Playnews.
